summary.text: Outlaws of Thunder Junction is set in the desert plane of Thunder Junction, where Oko recruits a crew that includes Annie Flash and his newly found son Kellan to rob Maag Taranau, a vault that the dragon Akul built the town of Tarnation around.
The crew steals the keys, but Oko leaks Tarnation's location to the Sterling Company to cover his escape and leaves Kellan behind, and Kellan then sides with Ral Zarek against him.

At the vault, Ashiok turns out to be Jace Beleren, who takes a sleeping infant from it while Kellan commands Akul back inside and the vault vanishes into the clouds, and in a separate thread Jace and Vraska, recovering on Vryn, settle on a plan of rebirth for the broken Multiverse.
